column1: # Ratchet baseline for Test.Parity: corpus <TAB> check <TAB> total <TAB> passing.
# `passing` is how many checks of that kind passed when this file was written.
# The test fails when the current number is LOWER, so waves 2..6 lower these
# numbers instead of touching the corpora. `total` must always equal the real
# number of checks, which pins the corpus files against silent truncation.
# Starting point, recorded right after Wave 1: hewts has the token layer and a
# grammar, but no orthography rules and no stack resolution yet, so most
# differences are real work for waves 2..6. Warnings are not checked at all —
# hewts has no warning channel yet (see README.md).
